name: ZAG Maribor Unit
zag_role: ZAG regional unit for north-east Slovenia
description: Opened in 2021, replacing the 1972 Maribor premises. It serves construction testing and site work across Podravska and Pomurska.
history: The Maribor business unit is at Kidričeva cesta 47, Dobrovce, 2204 Miklavž na Dravskem polju. It moved there from Gorkega ulica 1 in Maribor and the new premises opened on 19 October 2021. The unit occupies a renovated three storey building of 480 square metres, with offices and laboratories taking the whole of the ground floor, and the investment was about 300,000 euros. It has ten employees. The then director Aleš Žnidarič explained the move as driven by the formation of the cohesion regions and by the wish to bring together research laboratories that had been dispersed across several locations. The work of the unit spans materials, building physics, structures, geotechnics, transport infrastructure and metrology.

source_differences: Record calls 1972 premises 'Gorkega ulica 1', not checked. ZAG's 2024 book says the unit worked from 1972 in residential apartments (stanovanjski prostori).

Height of cadastre building 1809: the cadastre gives 8.4 m for the highest point above the terrain, while 99 % of the laser scan surface inside the outline stays below 10.5 m and its middle is at 7.9 m. Laser scanning of Slovenia (GURS, CLSS, file series NDMP), read 12 November 2026.
Year: the record gives 2021 for the opening of the premises, the cadastre gives 2000 as the year the building was built.

laser_scan.source: GURS, laser scanning of Slovenia (CLSS), file series NDMP, 0.5 m pixels. The values are read as heights above the ground. This reading rests on the agreement with the cadastre heights, since no official description of the series was found
